B2.question: Relative to the frame width, is the centre of the face left of centre, centred, or right of centre?
Relative to the frame height, is the centre of the face in the upper, middle, or lower third?
Does the face itself occupy less than one quarter, about one quarter to one half, or more than half of the picture area?
Is the bottom of the chin cut off by the lower edge of this picture?
Is any part of the forehead cut off by the upper edge of this picture?
Is either cheek cut off by a side edge of the picture?
Is there an empty gap between the top of the head and the upper picture edge?
Is the line joining the two eyes approximately level, tilted clockwise, or tilted counterclockwise in the picture?

appearance_holdout.question: Is this picture rendered in colour or entirely in shades of grey?
Does this image look like a photograph or a drawn illustration?
Is there any printed text or a watermark overlaid on this picture?
Is there a visible decorative border enclosing this picture?
Are conspicuous square compression blocks or coarse pixelation visible across the face?
Does the facial region have noticeable speckled image noise or film grain?
